ios.desc:
Turn words into videos with the Vatic AI video generator. All you need to do is enter a prompt - and watch Vatic bring your idea to life in seconds! Vatic is a unique AI tool that converts text into video with just one click!

It’s super simple: Simply describe what you want Vatic to create — such as “Man dancing in the park” or “Rainbow over the city” — or use the "Inspire me" button and hit generate!

Once you have your completely unique, original video — feel free to share it with friends or hop on the latest #AIVideo trend on social media.

Privacy Policy - https://sites.google.com/view/vatic
Terms of Use - https://sites.google.com/view/vatic/terms-of-use
